title: pm-dispatch(cross-repo): the split rule still keeps the local half of a card that involves cloud in this repo
body:
Filing-gate class ① — a seam found by a contract review, under a standing maintainer rule. The director's review of PR #26972 (card #26762, record 6456495962) measured it; the `domain:skills#1` seat re-read it on `main`. Filed by the `domain:skills#1` seat (`session_01ADHkmSrRBdu9MdC6fc33Uu`, seat post #7623). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Rule (maintainer, verbatim, from #26762):** 「应该更新分诊和 skills，一个issue只要涉及 cloud ，就归 cloud pm 处理」.

**Measured:** after PR #26972, the `domain:cloud` row and `references/triage-duties.md` park every card that involves cloud unless it is already in flight. But `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L44–45 still say a card spanning an unreachable repo is split by repo and 「本卡只留本仓活」, i.e. its local half stays and is dispatched here. Two rules, two answers for the same card.

**Wanted:** L44, same-line edit, ≤120 B, no new line: a card that involves cloud is parked whole (`domain:cloud` + `status:parked`); the in-flight exception stays where it already is (L46 and the triage-duties in-flight line). A ready commit exists from the #26762 card thread (`08f56392`, patch at `/mnt/project-files/skills-seat/26762-l44-followup.patch`), measured green on `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose` and 22 derived families; it could not ride #26972 because that PR was already in the merge queue.

**Order:** after PR #26972 lands (same rule set).

**Acceptance:** `cross-repo-coordination.md` and `triage-duties.md` give one answer for a card that involves cloud; line ratchet green (47 lines unchanged).

**Size:** XS. Tier S (`.claude/**`). `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**Dedupe:** open `domain:skills` issues read by REST for `cross-repo-coordination` → none.
